scenes.title: SCENE 1. A bare stage in darkness.
scenes.body:
A FIGURE stands in the dark, holding an unread letter.
FIGURE: I remember nothing of the way here.
A VOICE: You have been here before.
FIGURE: Then I will walk until I remember.

Figure: I remember nothing of the way here.
